Obtain a new Granillusion series weapon.
Then upgrade a Granillusion series weapon to an Ascillusion series weapon with "Equipment Upgrade (Augment Transfer)" at the Item Exchange Shop.

*Required Enhancement Materials:
Granillusion Volt I, Progre Grinder
